summary: Derive the frequency ladder and fixed seed, then solve a signed complex Ronnmark kx root at every frequency.

capability: Derive the frequency ladder and fixed seed, then solve a signed complex Ronnmark kx root at every frequency.
operation: scan complex kinetic kx roots over the frequency ladder
SI equilibrium controls and dimensionless ladder bounds to signed complex kx roots
discovery.boundary: zero kz is allowed; roots retain sign and nonpositive exit flags remain observable

identity.relation: SI equilibrium controls and dimensionless ladder bounds to signed complex kx roots
identity.direction: SI equilibrium controls and dimensionless ladder bounds to signed complex kx roots
identity.definition: The graph derives its ordered frequency ladder from wn and a single kx_start=kx_scale*kn; the bounded root solver repeats that seed independently at every frequency.
identity.coordinates: complex perpendicular wavenumber plane; kz is an absolute input
identity.boundary: zero kz is allowed; roots retain sign and nonpositive exit flags remain observable
assumptions: All species controls describe one shared equilibrium snapshot.

inputs.name: ms
inputs.description: Species masses, entering the thermal speed and the cyclotron frequency
inputs.constraints: Finite positive masses, one value per species.

inputs.name: qs
inputs.description: Species charges, setting the sign of the cyclotron frequency
inputs.constraints: Finite nonzero charges, one value per species.

inputs.name: ns_unit
inputs.description: Species densities as multiples of the reference density
inputs.constraints: Finite positive density ratios matching the species axis.

inputs.name: Ts_unit
inputs.description: Species temperatures as multiples of the reference temperature
inputs.constraints: Finite positive temperature ratios matching the species axis.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Background magnetic-field strength, calibrating the cyclotron-frequency scale

inputs.name: T00
inputs.constraints: Finite positive reference temperature in eV.

inputs.name: omega_scale
inputs.description: Start multiple of the scanned frequency ladder; multiplied by wn it gives the first angular frequency
inputs.constraints: Finite scan start; every derived angular frequency must be nonzero.

inputs.name: omega_step
inputs.description: Step multiple of the scanned frequency ladder; multiplied by wn it gives the spacing between adjacent frequency points; both source scans use 0.05

inputs.name: omega_stop
inputs.description: End multiple of the scanned frequency ladder (3.95 in the source); together with the start and step it fixes the source's colon expression, from which the number of ladder points follows
inputs.constraints: Finite scan endpoint not below the start.

inputs.name: kz
inputs.description: Absolute parallel wavenumber, the kz fixed by the source driver (2*5.0 for case 1 and 0.0 for case 2), entering the parallel resonance argument; the caller supplies this physical control directly, with no conversion from any reference wavenumber
inputs.constraints: Finite absolute parallel wavenumber; zero is supported by the kinetic paths.

inputs.name: kx_scale
inputs.description: Complex initial value shared by all frequency points as a fraction of kn; the source fixes it at 0.6 and performs no continuation between frequency points

inputs.name: tol_fun
inputs.description: Relative residual convergence tolerance corresponding to the reference runtime `TolFun`

inputs.name: tol_x
inputs.description: Relative variable-step convergence tolerance corresponding to the reference runtime `Tolx`

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.description: Maximum iterations per frequency point, corresponding to the reference runtime `MaxIter`

inputs.name: max_function_evals
inputs.description: Maximum objective-function evaluations per frequency point, corresponding to the reference runtime `MaxFunEvals`

outputs.name: scales
outputs.description: Per-species scales derived from the equilibrium inputs, shared by the wavenumber calibration and root finding
outputs.units: mixed (each key carries its own units)
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: kz
outputs.description: Parallel wavenumber actually used in this scan, taken directly from the caller's absolute control value
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: Number of frequency points derived from the source colon ladder (omega_scale:omega_step:omega_stop)
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: omegas
outputs.description: Angular-frequency sequence actually used in this scan
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: kx_start
outputs.description: Starting complex initial value for continuation root finding
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: roots
outputs.description: Complex perpendicular-wavenumber root obtained at each frequency point
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: residuals
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: determinant_scale
outputs.description: Maximum modulus of the dielectric-tensor elements at each root, used as the cancellation scale for the residual
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: exit_flags
outputs.description: The reference runtime fsolve exit flag at each frequency point, restricted to {1,2,3,0,-2,-3}
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: iterations
outputs.description: Iteration count actually used at each frequency point
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: function_evals
outputs.description: Objective-evaluation count actually used at each frequency point
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: Whether the exit flag is positive at each frequency point, that is, whether the reference runtime judged convergence
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: solver
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: graph_order
outputs.description: Fixed execution-order label for this graph
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: The first invalid graph control or dependency input raises ValueError; no partial result mapping is returned.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency numerical errors propagate without fallback; solver diagnostics remain observable where returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Root exit flags remain in the result.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

edges.description: The frequency ladder is scaled by the reference frequency wn, and its length follows the fixed colon expression; the scan and the equilibrium state must come from the same source
The initial value is scaled by the same kn, keeping the continuation start consistent with the wavenumber normalization
The frequency ladder is the independent-variable sequence for root finding; each point is solved independently with the same fixed initial value
The fixed initial value determines which root is converged to and must be given explicitly; the source uses the same initial value at all frequency points
Absolute number density enters the plasma frequency; root finding and the equilibrium state must come from the same source
Kelvin temperature enters the thermal speed and the pole-resonance argument
